## Growth handoff

Select exactly one label. The **Growth classification** check fails if neither
label exists or if both labels are present.

- [ ] `growth-content` — user-facing or externally meaningful; create a Notion marketing intake item after merge.
- [ ] `skip-growth` — no meaningful content value; do not create a Notion marketing intake item.

For `skip-growth`, leave the fields below empty. For `growth-content`, complete
every field. Use `N/A` only when no asset or demo exists yet.

Update type: <!-- New Feature | Improvement | Bug Fix | Launch | Partnership | Validator or Network Update | Delegation or Capacity | Infrastructure or Hardware | Data or Milestone | Announcement or Event | Incident or Recovery | Deprecation -->

User-facing change: <!-- One concise, plain-English description of what users can now see, do, or experience. -->

Why it matters: <!-- Explain the user or business value, not the implementation. -->

Target users: <!-- Comma-separated: SUI Holders, Stakers, Validators, Developers, Partners or Foundation, Community -->

User impact: <!-- Low | Medium | High -->

Suggested content angle: <!-- A useful post, changelog, announcement, or campaign angle. -->

Assets / demo: <!-- Add a screenshot, recording, preview URL, or N/A. -->

<!--
Use skip-growth for typography or formatting, routine dependency and CI maintenance,
internal refactoring, database maintenance with no user impact, or tiny fixes with no
useful external story. Use growth-content only when users can see, use, or benefit
from the change and the completed handoff gives Growth a credible story.
